name: arith_totient_add_sigma_eq_two_mul_iff_prime
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : n.totient + ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n = 2 * n ↔ n.Prime
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n), n.totient + ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n = 2 * n ↔ n.Prime
informal: Equality case of the Sandor–Atanassov inequality φ(n)+σ(n) ≥ 2n (Mathlib2.p5_lemma2): equality iff n is prime — for composite n with least prime factor p, σ(n) ≥ n + n/p + 1 and φ(n) ≥ n - n/p (count of multiples of p is not all non-coprime... use φ(n) ≥ n - Σ_{q|n} n/q carefully, or induct with Mathlib2.p5_sigma_prime_mul_of_dvd), giving strict inequality.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → (n.totient + (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) n = 2 * n ↔ Nat.Prime n)
